seo.title: Join Pakistan's Free Fintech Community on WhatsApp
seo.description: A free WhatsApp community for founders, operators, regulators and banks building fintech in Pakistan. Four focused channels and monthly meetups.

hero.title: The Fintech Pakistan community
hero.lede: A free WhatsApp community for everyone building money in Pakistan. Focused channels, monthly meetups, and people working on the same problems you are.

channels.heading: Four channels
channels.intro: Join the community once, then follow the channels that matter to you.

cards.label: Channel
cards.title: General
cards.text: Introductions, conversation and what everyone is working on.

cards.label: Channel
cards.title: News & Regulation
cards.text: Industry news and regulatory updates that affect how you build and operate.

cards.label: Channel
cards.title: Ask & Help
cards.text: Bring a problem. Someone here may already have solved it.

cards.label: Channel
cards.title: Jobs & Opportunities
cards.text: Roles, partnerships and openings across the ecosystem.

who.heading: If you build, run or regulate money in Pakistan,

steps.title: Join
steps.text: Tap the WhatsApp link and join the community.

steps.title: Introduce yourself
steps.text: Say who you are and what you're building in General.

steps.title: Pick your channels
steps.text: Follow the channels you care about and mute the rest.

rules.heading: House rules
rules.intro: A few rules so the community stays useful as it grows.

items.title: No cold pitches
items.text: Share launches and news in the right channel. Don't send unsolicited sales DMs.

items.title: Share your source
items.text: Post news with a link, so others can read it for themselves.

items.title: Post in the right channel
items.text: Jobs go in Jobs, questions go in Ask & Help.

items.title: What's said here stays here
items.text: Don't screenshot or forward members' messages without asking.

faqs.a: Yes. The community is free to join and free to stay in.
Anyone working in or around fintech in Pakistan, including teams building for the Pakistani market from abroad.

faqs.q: Can I post about my company?
faqs.a: Yes, in the right channel. Launches, hiring and news are welcome. Unsolicited sales messages are not.
Yes. We run monthly meetups and larger events through FP Live. Members hear about them first.
